exposure: written birth stories (vaginal birth with positive/negative evaluation)
written birth stories (caesarean birth with positive/negative evaluation)
outcome: fear of labour and vaginal birth
cohort: Nulligravid women (N = 426) were randomly allocated to different conditions of birth story exposure.
finding: Variations in the type of birth (vaginal/caesarean) and storyteller evaluation (positive/negative) in birth stories significantly influenced nulligravid women's childbirth preferences.
mod_finding: The effect of vaginal birth stories on preference was significantly mediated by changes in fear of labour and vaginal birth and self-efficacy, whereas effects of exposure to caesarean birth stories were not explained by changes in fear or self-efficacy.
